limitations: An initial final-integration full run exhausted shared PostgreSQL connection slots (569 passed, 3 failed). Stopped our completed e2e servers and reran the complete suite with maxWorkers=2. The earlier c14c56782 platform run had timeouts in map-play UI and sign-in handoff while concurrent builds were active. Both suites passed unchanged on isolated retry. Original failure log is retained; no deterministic cause established.
Physical tablet/touch/pen hardware and Windows/macOS/Android native builds were not tested.

Loaded editor-suite measurements and post-build measurements are both retained; this shared host also had unrelated workloads. Software-rendered headless Chromium timings do not establish the hardware 60fps target. Input-driven FPS includes automation event pacing.
Browser-game WebGL rendering exercised Chromium serial and pthread paths; browser authorization exercised all three engines. No pixel-equivalence claim across native/editor/browser.
Requires deployment migration 0038_skin_view_angle.sql. No production deployment or external database migration performed.
